title: Mexican Sirloin Fajitas
description: Sizzling sirloin strips and sautéed vegetables, served with warm flour tortillas. This Mexican-inspired dish is perfect for a quick and flavorful meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sirloin steak and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Transfer the steak to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the bell pepper and onion and cook for 4-5 minutes, or until tender.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the fajita seasoning and stir to combine.
Return the steak to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Serve the steak and vegetables with pasta and warm flour tortillas.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
